title: Trentina
description: Trentina gateway traffic from its OTLP export (docs/grafana-dashboard.md). Source: crunchtools/trentina contrib/grafana.

panels.title: Gateway calls

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.description: Every call Trentina handled in the time range: MCP tool calls, model calls through the LLM proxy, fetches and egress tunnels. One call is one span from Trentina's OTLP export.

panels.title: Refused or failed

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome != "ok")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.description: Calls whose outcome was anything but ok: defense blocks, allowlist and guard denials, decoy trips, tool and backend errors. Not a failure count: most of these are policy doing its job. See 'Calls by outcome' for the split.

panels.title: Flagged by the defense

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.layer)
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.description: Calls where L1 (patterns), L2 (local classifier) or L3 (LLM judge) raised a detection, blocked or not. In flag mode a flagged call is still delivered, with a warning attached, so this is usually larger than blocked_defense.

panels.title: p95 duration

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group()
  |> quantile(q: 0.95)

panels.description: 95% of calls finished faster than this, end to end through the gateway, including the backend's own time and the defense scan.

panels.title: Calls by outcome

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["outcome"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "outcome"])

panels.description: Calls per interval, one line per outcome. ok: answered normally. tool_error: the backend reported an error. blocked_defense: the defense refused the content. denied_*: a policy you configured refused it. decoy_tripped: an agent touched a decoy (worth a look). backend_error: upstream failed. gateway_error: a Trentina bug, the only one that should page.

panels.title: Calls by profile

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["profile"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "profile"])

panels.description: Calls per interval for each agent seat (profile). A seat that suddenly multiplies its rate is the first thing to look at in a runaway agent.

panels.title: Detections by layer

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.layer)
  |> group(columns: ["layer"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "layer"])

panels.description: Calls credited to each defense layer: L1 pattern rules, L2 the local classifier model, L3 the LLM judge. A burst of L2 with no matching L3 flags usually means L2 false positives, not an attack.

panels.title: Top flagged tools

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.layer)
  |> group(columns: ["backend", "tool", "layer"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "calls"})
  |> keep(columns: ["backend", "tool", "layer", "calls"])

panels.description: Which backend and tool drew the most detections, and from which layer. The same read-only tool flagged over and over by L2 alone is a false-positive candidate; a write tool flagged by L3 deserves a look at the audit log by call_ref.

panels.title: Duration p50 / p95 by kind

targets.query:
p50 = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with destination_kind: if exists r.destination_kind then r.destination_kind else "tool"}))
  |> group(columns: ["destination_kind"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: median, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.destination_kind + " p50"}))

p95 = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with destination_kind: if exists r.destination_kind then r.destination_kind else "tool"}))
  |> group(columns: ["destination_kind"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column), createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.destination_kind + " p95"}))

union(tables: [p50, p95])
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.description: Median and 95th-percentile duration, split by what the call reached: tool (MCP backend), fetch, model, tunnel and so on. p95 climbing while p50 holds is usually one slow backend.

panels.title: Egress tunnels by profile

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.destination_kind == "tunnel")
  |> group(columns: ["profile"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "profile"])

panels.description: CONNECT tunnels each agent opened through Trentina's client egress, i.e. direct network connections. Spikes are agents fetching outside their tools.

panels.title: Model calls refused or failed by profile

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trentina_calls" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.destination_kind == "model" and r.outcome != "ok")
  |> group(columns: ["outcome"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "outcome"])

panels.description: Calls through the LLM proxy that did not come back ok, by outcome. A provider spend cap or outage shows here as backend_error; a refused request body as denied_guard.
